definitions.gloss: advertising fee; advertising charge; ad revenue
definitions.explanation: The money paid for placing an advertisement, or the revenue earned from carrying advertisements.

examples.japanese: {広告料|こうこくりょう}を{払|はら}ってCMを{出|だ}す。
examples.english: To pay an advertising fee to run a commercial.

examples.japanese: この{雑誌|ざっし}は{広告料|こうこくりょう}で{成|な}り{立|た}っている。
examples.english: This magazine is sustained by advertising revenue.

examples.japanese: ネット{広告|こうこく}の{広告料|こうこくりょう}はクリック{数|すう}に{応|おう}じて{変|か}わる。
examples.english: Online advertising fees change depending on the number of clicks.

notes:
{広告|こうこく} (advertisement) + {料|りょう} (fee, charge). Can refer both to the cost of placing an ad and to the revenue earned from hosting ads. Common in media, marketing, and business discussions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {広告料|こうこくりょう}を{払|はら}う — pay advertising fees
- {広告料|こうこくりょう}{収入|しゅうにゅう} — advertising revenue
- {広告料|こうこくりょう}が{高|たか}い — advertising fees are high
- {広告料|こうこくりょう}で{運営|うんえい}する — operate on advertising revenue

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {広告費|こうこくひ} — advertising expenses — focuses on the cost side from the advertiser's perspective
- {掲載料|けいさいりょう} — publication fee; listing fee — the fee for having something published or listed
- {広告|こうこく}{収入|しゅうにゅう} — advertising income — specifically the revenue side
